description: Designed in the Marin County Starfleet Yards, the U.S.S. Enterprise M414 was almost a Federation flagship. The project was scrapped only weeks before construction was due to begin. The designs have been sold, bartered, and passed down for generations, exchanging hands until they finally found their home with the Forsaken. The U.S.S. Enterprise M414 has been modernized and brought into the 24th century, but her foundations remain. And what better way for the Forsaken to soothe the sting of rejection than by reviving a Federation ship and making it their own?

ship_ability.title: Apex Aegis
ship_ability.description: Increases Apex Barrier by +{value} at the start of combat versus players (does not apply to Stations).
